assign.outcome:
**One icon system is live at [/framework/ui/icon/](/framework/ui/icon/)** — every demo at 14, 18 and 28px, side by side.

![](build/127-0-0-1-59870-framework-ui-icon/1920.png)

- [x] audit of every icon use: [audit](audit/audit.md), 6 patterns, 6 one-offs ranked, [shots](audit/shots/)
- [x] the facts: Material Icons are fixed width (square 1em); inline icons sat ~4px high; a frame is only for a click target, centring in a taller box, or equal slots: [facts](audit/facts.md), [doc](/framework/ui/icon/doc/)
- [x] icon alone, framed and not; button flush, backed, hover, toggle; mixed rail; items boxed and flat: the 1920 shot above
- [x] frame sized in em, so a bigger font scales icon, frame and padding: the three size columns
- [x] worst offenders migrated: inline alignment fixed once in .icon (paging's hand nudge removed); Panel's copy-pasted button CSS now one copy
- [x] css skill Icons section: sent to mastermind-servex-8, landed as 11d055e4
- [ ] Panel buttons still use their own class; mode button, search bar, scenes bar, hero sizes listed under Not migrated yet in doc/icons.md
- [ ] hover edge vs parent edge: the flat item sits a little lower than the boxed one; a lone unlabelled ruler button tops the demo

Left: .icon's vertical-align touches every inline icon, checked on 6 pages only; Panel's toolbar.css/toolbar.js are dead and can go. Cost about $12.3, over the $12 cap by the second review (the pool wiped two worktrees).
